facts.fact: The draft National Policy on Data and Cloud, gazetted on 1 April 2021, states the justice, crime prevention and security cluster issued the 2015 National Cybersecurity Policy Framework.

The draft policy, gazetted on 1 April 2021, defines the Cybersecurity Hub as a computer security incident response team and directs the Minister to keep it capacitated to respond to threats, treating it as existing; as_of is the gazette date.

systems.tiers: a CSIRT pooling public and private threat information

note: The draft defines national critical information infrastructure and requires its data to be kept onshore, but designates none.
